# Julian Norton

> Julian Norton is a product leader in New York City specializing in AI and LLM systems, with a focus on protecting products from bots, fraud, and AI-agent abuse. He is a Staff Product Manager at HUMAN Security, and former co-founder and CEO of Plum AI (acquired in 2025), an LLM evaluation platform.

Expertise: AI product management, LLM evaluation and quality, bot detection and mitigation, fraud and abuse prevention, AI-agent security, cybersecurity.

## Current roles

- [HUMAN Security](https://www.humansecurity.com/): Staff Product Manager. Protection across human, bot, and AI agent interactions.

## Previous roles

- [Plum AI (Plum Defense Inc.)](https://getplum.ai/): Co-founder and CEO. Evaluates and automatically improves the quality of LLM applications.
- [SecurityScorecard](https://www.securityscorecard.com/): Senior Product Manager. Security ratings and supply-chain risk intelligence.
- [Order.co](https://www.order.co/): Sr. Product Manager. Purchasing and spend management for businesses.
- [Implicit (formerly Agolo)](https://www.agolo.com/): Product Manager. NLP platform that turns unstructured documents into structured knowledge.
